scope: One immutable recipe version has exactly two typed count-unit input roles and two typed count-unit output roles. One complete batch creates the four stable managed children; drafts contribute no stock and expose no child output.

A stock-account-owned gross-input root aggregates batch input demand at each exact timestamp. Each input validator compares the gross demand in [T,T+1ns) with stock available before T. The stock-history membership is dependent so earlier stock edits and deletion revalidate later batches.

A managed output child owns a dated output-use capacity root. An optional typed stock_out.assembly_output link adds only an output-capacity use; the stock_out remains the single physical stock debit. The link is writable at creation and READONLY afterward, including omission for ordinary stock_out rows.

observed: Incomplete drafts create no managed legs and do not change stock; changing to complete creates both input and both output roles with stable source/role IDs.
A duplicate create using the completed batch ID rejects with full source/child/root snapshot equality; repeating the complete state update preserves the same child IDs and summaries.

A recipe with both inputs and both outputs on the same stock account reconstructs 10 opening stock plus net movement -6 and gross input 6, with the two input roles aggregated on the separate gross root.
Zero-prior same-time input 1/output 1 rejects despite net stock delta 0. A 6+6 same-time demand against opening 10 rejects atomically; repeating with reverse record-ID order also rejects atomically.

The nanosecond interval fixture accepts input at T and at T+750us with a replenishment at T+500us, while the oracle observes exact-T demand 6 and hypothetical 1ms-range demand 12. Earlier as-of stock remains 6.

Reducing or deleting an earlier stock_in grant, backdating a completed batch before that grant, and reducing/dating/removing an output already used by stock_out all reject with full snapshot equality.

A linked dispatch consumes output capacity and posts one stock debit. Clearing or changing the link after creation rejects; mismatched output/source account rejects. An ordinary unlinked stock_out succeeds.

Removing and re-completing an unused output-producing batch prunes and restores its two output children with stable role identities. Source rows independently reconstruct stock, gross input, and output-use roots.
limits: This is a bounded H7 immediate-assembly profile/probe, not a production migration or general recipe interpreter. It has exactly two input roles and two output roles, one entity, integer count quantities, and no user formula or array manifest.

A partial set of child roles cannot be created through public writes: all role children are fixed by the required-output recipe and their tables deny direct writes. Draft state is the supported incomplete form.
The output-use link covers only stock_out consumption of a managed assembly output. It does not implement general lot tracking, substitutions, work-in-process stages, or H8 behavior.
The exact [T,T+1ns) behavior is demonstrated on SurrealDB 3.2.0 only. The H7 feasibility record remains a separate pre-code checkpoint.
